title: What If You Lived on the Space Station? You'd Time Travel

scenes.text: What if you lived on the space station? You'd become a time traveler, by a tiny amount.
The station flies at about 27,500 kilometers an hour, circling Earth roughly every ninety minutes.
Moving that fast makes your clock tick slightly slower than clocks on the ground. It's real physics.
After six months in orbit, you'd be about 0.007 seconds younger than people back home.
Cosmonaut Sergei Krikalev, after 803 days in orbit, jumped about 0.02 seconds into the future.
That's less than a blink. So yes, you'd time travel, but you'd never notice it.
